import sys
import numpy as np

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    cards = []
    idx = 1
    for _ in range(n):
        a = int(data[idx]); b = int(data[idx + 1]); idx += 2
        cards.append((a, b))

    edges = []
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            if cards[i][0] == cards[j][0] or cards[i][1] == cards[j][1]:
                edges.append((1 << i) | (1 << j))

    M = 1 << n
    masks = np.arange(M, dtype=np.int64)
    pc = np.zeros(M, dtype=np.int64)
    for b in range(n):
        pc += (masks >> b) & 1

    order = np.argsort(pc, kind='stable')
    counts = np.bincount(pc, minlength=n + 1)
    bounds = np.concatenate(([0], np.cumsum(counts)))
    sorted_masks = masks[order]

    win = np.zeros(M, dtype=bool)
    for p in range(n + 1):
        layer = sorted_masks[bounds[p]:bounds[p + 1]]
        if layer.size == 0:
            continue
        for e in edges:
            sub = layer[(layer & e) == e]
            if sub.size:
                win[sub] |= ~win[sub ^ e]

    if win[M - 1]:
        print("Takahashi")
    else:
        print("Aoki")
